entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me which item you're calling about?
Okay, I see your recent order for the AeroPro helmet. To get this started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color. It's not right. The box is still unopened.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. I'm just pulling up your order details... I see it was delivered 15 days ago.
Right. And for a key piece of safety equipment, you'd think the pictures would be more accurate. Whatever.
I can appreciate that completely. Let me check our policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. It looks like standard items like your helmet are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now.
Fine. So you'll send a label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5-10 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office.
Great. Another errand to run. Thanks.
You're welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
